panels.title: 近 7 日 Top 模型 (按消耗积分)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(model_code, '<unset>') AS model, count(*) AS calls, sum(amount)::bigint AS total_credits, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS users, round((sum(amount)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*),0)), 2) AS avg_per_call FROM billing.events WHERE kind IN ('consume','settle') AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_credits DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT COALESCE(model_code, '<unset>') AS metric, sum(amount)::bigint AS value FROM billing.events WHERE kind IN ('consume','settle') AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top 5 模型每小时调用量 (近 24h)

targets.rawSql: WITH top5 AS (SELECT model_code FROM billing.events WHERE kind IN ('consume','settle') AND model_code IS NOT NULL AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY model_code ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT date_trunc('hour', occurred_at) AS time, e.model_code AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM billing.events e JOIN top5 USING (model_code) WHERE kind IN ('consume','settle') AND occurred_at >= $__timeFrom() AND occurred_at < $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
